_what: Account state immediately BEFORE scripts/provision_wix_catalog_webhook.py --apply created the Wix catalogue webhook receiver. This is the rollback target.
_rollback: aws apigatewayv2 delete-route      --api-id zllr9lrg7j --route-id <the POST /wix-catalog-webhook route>
aws apigatewayv2 delete-integration --api-id zllr9lrg7j --integration-id <the AWS_PROXY onto wecare-wix-catalog-webhook:live>
_rollback_note: Every one of those is in block_catastrophic.py's DESTRUCTIVE_AWS table and therefore ASKS before running. Nothing else is touched: the change is purely additive, so rollback is deletion of exactly what was added and no pre-existing resource needs restoring. Catalogue auto-sync survives the rollback intact - .github/workflows/catalogue-sync.yml needs no AWS resource at all.

secretsmanager._note: wecare/wix/catalog-webhook is ABSENT and stays absent: creating it requires the Wix app public key, which is owner-only work (WAITING_FOR_OWNER in docs/wix-catalogue-auto-sync.md). The receiver therefore answers 401 to everything until the owner acts, which is the correct resting state for an endpoint whose success path starts a production build.
